source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The shared IMAP head defines one MessageGenerator and addImapMessage returns the generated message after adding its data URI to the fake mailbox. The lock test can then compare the delivered/stored body with that exact generated subject instead of duplicating message setup or relying on a fixed incidental subject. This is a shared test-helper contract, not a general preference for global state in application code.
title: Return the generated fake-server message when its body is part of the assertion
